dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「は〜い、じゃあ今日は物理の担当します。皆
　さん宜しくお願いしますね〜♪」
dialogues.en: "Hi! I'm in charge of Physics today."
dialogues.text: "Hi! I'm in charge of Physics today."

dialogues.jp: いつものように、さくらが元気良く挨拶する。
dialogues.en: Sakura greets the class energetically as usual.
dialogues.text: Sakura greets the class energetically as usual.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「さて、皆さんは物理なんて社会に出たら役に
　立たないと思っているでしょうが、実はびっ
　くりです！」
dialogues.en:
"Now, you may think you never use physics after graduating
school, but actually, you'd be surprised."
dialogues.text:
"Now, you may think you never use physics after graduating
school, but actually, you'd be surprised."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「一部の方を除いては、これが本当に役に立ち
　ません……」
dialogues.en: "It's certainly really useless for some people."
dialogues.text: "It's certainly really useless for some people."

dialogues.jp:
頬杖をつきながら、どうしても周囲の様子を気
にしてしまう。
dialogues.en: I look around, resting my chin in the hand.
dialogues.text: I look around, resting my chin in the hand.

dialogues.jp:
声や目立った行動はないが、教室の中に明らか
な不信の空気がまじっている。
dialogues.en:
I don't see any suspicious behavior, but obviously there is
a mood of public distrust in the class.
dialogues.text:
I don't see any suspicious behavior, but obviously there is
a mood of public distrust in the class.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「でもでもね、皆さんが人間の力を超えている
　なんていう――奇跡なんていうのは、実はこ
　の物理と数学の上に成り立っているんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"But, but... Something transcending the bounds of human
power which people call a miracle is actually based on
physics and mathematics."
dialogues.text:
"But, but... Something transcending the bounds of human
power which people call a miracle is actually based on
physics and mathematics."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「もちろん核とかが分かりやすいだろうけど、
　医療の場の薬とかだってそうなんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"You may understand how the nucleus is made, but medicine in
the medical field is based on that, too."
dialogues.text:
"You may understand how the nucleus is made, but medicine in
the medical field is based on that, too."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ウイルスとかワクチンとかあるけど、あれも
　突き詰めれば化学反応だし、紙に鉛筆で字を
　書くのだってそうだからね♪」
dialogues.en:
"When you think about viruses or vaccines, they are also
created by a chemical reaction, and writing on paper is the
same thing, too."
dialogues.text:
"When you think about viruses or vaccines, they are also
created by a chemical reaction, and writing on paper is the
same thing, too."

dialogues.jp:
この空気が俺の気のせいなのか……確かめるの
は簡単だった。
dialogues.en: I don't know if this is just me, but it's easy to find out.
dialogues.text: I don't know if this is just me, but it's easy to find out.

dialogues.jp: 「……なぁ、杉並」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Suginami..."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Suginami..."

dialogues.jp: とん、と背中をつつく。
dialogues.en: I poke his back.
dialogues.text: I poke his back.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと待て……いいところだ」
dialogues.en: "Wait a second, this is the best part."
dialogues.text: "Wait a second, this is the best part."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp:
なんだか必死にノートをとっているようだが
……。
dialogues.en: I see he's making a note.
dialogues.text: I see he's making a note.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「と、まぁ、物理だけが大切だって話じゃない
　んだけどね。学ぶことが大切だって話だよ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I'm not saying physics is the most important subject.
What I want to say is learning is important."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I'm not saying physics is the most important subject.
What I want to say is learning is important."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「健康な心は、健康な肉体からということで体
　育も重要です……ボクは嫌いだけど」
dialogues.en:
"They say a healthy mind grows in a healthy body. Physical
exercise is also important... I don't like it, though."
dialogues.text:
"They say a healthy mind grows in a healthy body. Physical
exercise is also important... I don't like it, though."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「社会とか国語は心を豊かにします」
dialogues.en: "Social Study and Language broaden your mind."
dialogues.text: "Social Study and Language broaden your mind."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そう、人の心だけは化学反応じゃないんだよ♪
　……実際は色々とあるけどね」
dialogues.en:
"The human mind is the only thing not based on a chemical
reaction. In real life, you see many different kinds of
things."
dialogues.text:
"The human mind is the only thing not based on a chemical
reaction. In real life, you see many different kinds of
things."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「くっくっ……」
dialogues.en: "Nyuk, nyuk..."
dialogues.text: "Nyuk, nyuk..."

dialogues.jp: 面白いのか今の？
dialogues.en: What's funny?
dialogues.text: What's funny?

dialogues.jp:
ふと、ことりが口元を押さえているのを見かけ
たところによると、なにか知識を要求する冗談
だったらしい。
dialogues.en:
I can tell by seeing Kotori covering her mouth it must be a
joke you have to understand.
dialogues.text:
I can tell by seeing Kotori covering her mouth it must be a
joke you have to understand.

dialogues.jp: 皆を代表して分からないと思っておこう。
dialogues.en: I pretend I don't understand it as one of the rest.
dialogues.text: I pretend I don't understand it as one of the rest.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ま、恋心は化学反応じゃないから♪」
dialogues.en: "Well, love is not created by a chemical reaction."
dialogues.text: "Well, love is not created by a chemical reaction."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
最後の言葉にビッと横線をひいて、杉並が振り
返る。
dialogues.en: Suginami turns back with her last words.
dialogues.text: Suginami turns back with her last words.

dialogues.jp:
「蛍光ペンでマークをいれとけや今のところ
　……テストに出るぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Why don't you mark that line with a highlighter pen? It'll
be on the test."
dialogues.text:
"Why don't you mark that line with a highlighter pen? It'll
be on the test."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「理解できない事柄を丸暗記しても仕方ない」
dialogues.en: "It's useless to memorize if I don't understand."
dialogues.text: "It's useless to memorize if I don't understand."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「あ〜……最後のだけは皆にも理解できたと思
　うけどな」
dialogues.en:
"Ahhh... everybody can understand the last thing I said,
right?"
dialogues.text:
"Ahhh... everybody can understand the last thing I said,
right?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「で、どうした？」
dialogues.en: "So, what happened?"
dialogues.text: "So, what happened?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「さくらの――いや、後ででいいや」
dialogues.en: "Sakura... I'll tell you later."
dialogues.text: "Sakura... I'll tell you later."

dialogues.jp:
教室でのヒソヒソ話が、いかに響くのかなんて
周知の事実だ。
dialogues.en:
It's obvious to everyone how the whisper rings through the
classroom.
dialogues.text:
It's obvious to everyone how the whisper rings through the
classroom.

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと調べて欲しいことが――」
dialogues.en: "I want you to look up something..."
dialogues.text: "I want you to look up something..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「はい、そこ、私語は禁止です！　……よし♪」
dialogues.en: "Excuse me, there. No talking! ...Right."
dialogues.text: "Excuse me, there. No talking! ...Right."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
顔を上げると、さくらが嬉しそうにチョークを
振りかぶっているのが見えた。
dialogues.en:
When I lift my head, I see Sakura happily weighing the chalk
in her hand.
dialogues.text:
When I lift my head, I see Sakura happily weighing the chalk
in her hand.

dialogues.jp:
なにに影響されたのか知らないが……それはマ
ズイ。
dialogues.en:
I don't know what gave her the idea, but it doesn't look
good at all.
dialogues.text:
I don't know what gave her the idea, but it doesn't look
good at all.

dialogues.jp: そしてネタが古い。
dialogues.en: Besides, the material is old.
dialogues.text: Besides, the material is old.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「憧れのＳｈｏｏｔｓ♪」
dialogues.en: "Shot of yearning!"
dialogues.text: "Shot of yearning!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「俺が盾か！？」
dialogues.en: "Am I the target?"
dialogues.text: "Am I the target?"

dialogues.jp:
とっさに逃げようとした杉並の背中をおさえて、
その後ろに隠れる。
dialogues.en: I hold Suginami's back to hide behind him as he runs away.
dialogues.text: I hold Suginami's back to hide behind him as he runs away.

dialogues.jp: バキ――！
dialogues.en: Swt!
dialogues.text: Swt!

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「はずれたぞ朝倉」
dialogues.en: "It missed, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "It missed, Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうか……」

と、顔を上げるとクラス中の視線が俺のビ
ミョーに隣に集まっている。
dialogues.en:
When I lift my head, I see everybody's gaze at the person
right next to me.
dialogues.text:
When I lift my head, I see everybody's gaze at the person
right next to me.

dialogues.speaker: Tabata
dialogues.jp: 「田端ッ！？」
dialogues.en: "Tabata!"
dialogues.text: "Tabata!"

dialogues.jp:
付属でクラスメートだった、１日に一言しか喋
らないことで有名な男が、頭をのけぞらせた形
でそこにいた。
dialogues.en:
He was my classmate in the previous school, and he was
famous for speaking only one word a day. That person's
sitting right next to me with his head thrown back.
dialogues.text:
He was my classmate in the previous school, and he was
famous for speaking only one word a day. That person's
sitting right next to me with his head thrown back.

dialogues.jp: 「お前、同じクラスだったのか！？」
dialogues.en: "I didn't know you were in my class."
dialogues.text: "I didn't know you were in my class."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おいおい」
dialogues.en: "Hey, hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey, hey."

dialogues.jp: 駆け寄ってきたことりが俺にツッこむ。
dialogues.en: Kotori runs up to me to interrupt our conversation.
dialogues.text: Kotori runs up to me to interrupt our conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「田端君、大丈夫？」
dialogues.en: "Are you okay, Tabata-kun?"
dialogues.text: "Are you okay, Tabata-kun?"

dialogues.jp:
ことりの問いに、田端がなんでもない、と無言
で頷く。
dialogues.en: Tabata nods to Kotori's question without saying anything.
dialogues.text: Tabata nods to Kotori's question without saying anything.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「あの、さくら先生、とりあえず保健室に連れ
　て行ったほうがいいかと」
dialogues.en:
"Um... Sakura-sensei, I think we should take him to the
nurse's office."
dialogues.text:
"Um... Sakura-sensei, I think we should take him to the
nurse's office."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうだね……あははははは」
dialogues.en: "You're right. Hahahahaha."
dialogues.text: "You're right. Hahahahaha."

dialogues.jp:
無言で立ち上がる田端。怒ってはいない。俺に
は分かる。
dialogues.en: Tabata gets up with no words. I can tell he's not angry.
dialogues.text: Tabata gets up with no words. I can tell he's not angry.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ご、ごめんなさい田端くん」
dialogues.en: "S-sorry, Tabata-kun."
dialogues.text: "S-sorry, Tabata-kun."

dialogues.jp: やっぱり田端が無言で頷く。
dialogues.en: As expected, Tabata nods without saying anything.
dialogues.text: As expected, Tabata nods without saying anything.

dialogues.speaker: Tabata
dialogues.jp: 「気にするな先生」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry about me, Sakura-sensei."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry about me, Sakura-sensei."

dialogues.jp: ざわっ、とクラスの極一部に波紋が広がる。
dialogues.en: That causes a commotion among part of the class.
dialogues.text: That causes a commotion among part of the class.

dialogues.jp: ことりにすら声をかけなかったと言うのに……。
dialogues.en: He never said a word before, even to Kotori.
dialogues.text: He never said a word before, even to Kotori.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「しかし、これでさらにマズくなったな」
dialogues.en: "But this means it makes Sakura's situation worse."
dialogues.text: "But this means it makes Sakura's situation worse."

dialogues.jp:
杉並が俺に対して言ったのではないだろうが、
クラスの視線は痛いほどさくらの背中を見つめ
ていた。
dialogues.en:
I know Suginami didn't spell it out to me, but the whole
class has got it in for Sakura now.
dialogues.text:
I know Suginami didn't spell it out to me, but the whole
class has got it in for Sakura now.

dialogues.jp: 「かったりぃ……」
dialogues.en: "What a pain in the neck..."
dialogues.text: "What a pain in the neck..."

dialogues.jp:
田端を支えるというよりも、田端に抱え込まれ
るようにさくらが廊下に消える。
dialogues.en:
Sakura disappears into the hallway, being held up by Tabata
rather than supporting him.
dialogues.text:
Sakura disappears into the hallway, being held up by Tabata
rather than supporting him.

dialogues.jp: そして、自習。
dialogues.en: And we study by ourselves.
dialogues.text: And we study by ourselves.

dialogues.jp: ◆さくらの授業、田端語る◆
dialogues.en: ◆Tabata speaks up at Sakura's class◆
dialogues.text: ◆Tabata speaks up at Sakura's class◆

dialogues.jp: 物理の時間、勉強や恋愛の大切さを説くさくら。
dialogues.en:
Sakura was teaching her students how important it is to
learn and to love during Physics class.
dialogues.text:
Sakura was teaching her students how important it is to
learn and to love during Physics class.

dialogues.jp:
そんな最中、ついつい杉並と雑談していると、
なにに影響をされたのかさくらがチョークを投
げてきた。
dialogues.en:
I was talking with Suginami during Sakura's lecture, and
then she unexpectedly threw a piece of chalk at me.
dialogues.text:
I was talking with Suginami during Sakura's lecture, and
then she unexpectedly threw a piece of chalk at me.

dialogues.jp:
それがマズイことに、まったくの別人に当たっ
てしまう。ただでさえ例の噂があったのに、さ
くらの立場が困ったことになってきた……。
dialogues.en:
Unfortunately, it hit another guy, not me. That made
Sakura's situation worse than before.
dialogues.text:
Unfortunately, it hit another guy, not me. That made
Sakura's situation worse than before.
